component.name: Time Card Control Center
component.summary: Inspect OCP Time Card precision timing hardware

description.p: Time Card Control Center discovers Linux ptp_ocp devices and presents TAI-aware precision-clock, GNSS, timing I/O, FPGA, sensor, LED, and oscillator-discipline telemetry.
Hardware monitoring is read-only and runs without administrator access.
Initial native Rust, Relm4, GTK4, and libadwaita release.
